t: Approving Freeway Agreement Between State and City and County for Street Vacations and Extensions in Connection With the Construction of the Southern Freeway and the James Lick Freeway.

Meyer Construction Co. has requested through its engineers, Punnett, Parez and Hutchison, that certain streets in Miraloma Park be closed and abandoned so that said Meyer Construction Co. may resubdivide its property and open new streets in lieu of said…
Declaring Intention to Order the Vacation of an Unnamed Street Between Foerster and Verna Streets.
Ordering the Vacation of an Unnamed Street Between Foerster and Verna Streets.
Supervisor Halley, seconded by Supervisor Zirpoli, moved adoption.
